policy: A discovery catalog is not a security qualification. Entries never install code, receive case data or expand scope.

entries.name: PDF text extraction
entries.use: Extract native text before asking a model to read a document.

entries.name: PDF OCR
entries.use: Independent OCR pass for scans and extraction gaps; OCR can misread characters.

entries.name: Offline browser replay
entries.use: Inspect captured pages with an isolated browser. External resources and live browsing are blocked.

entries.name: Capture fingerprinting
entries.use: Find technology hints in captured responses. Hints do not prove a deployed product.

entries.name: Scoped contact extraction
entries.use: Extract domain-bound contacts from approved captures, without search-engine requests.

entries.name: Domain candidates
entries.use: Generate spelling candidates offline. No DNS, registration or availability checks.

entries.name: Username marker checks
entries.use: Check operator-specified presence and absence markers. A matching name never establishes identity.

entries.name: Maigret
entries.use: Reference for username research. Broad live enumeration is not enabled.

entries.name: SpiderFoot
entries.use: Reference for modular research. Modules, credentials and network effects require separate qualification.

entries.name: ExifTool
entries.use: Reference for metadata analysis. No executable adapter is included in this release.
